raw:
@q query
  select ?p
  where all
    match
      relation "buy corn at"
      role subject ?b
      role object ?p
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be"
      role subject ?b
      role object "Cerealcom Dolj"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end

@q2 query
  select ?p
  where all
    match
      relation "buy corn at"
      role subject ?b
      role object ?p
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be"
      role subject ?b
      role object "the base from Filiași"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "buy corn at"
  role object "0.85 lei per kilogram"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@a2 assumed
  relation "buy corn at"
  role object "0.9 lei per kilogram"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature
